description: Creates a new deploy record in Sentry to track the introduction of a release version into a specific environment.

dateFinished.description: An optional ISO 8601 formatted date-time string (UTC is recommended) indicating when the deployment process finished. If not provided, Sentry uses the time the deploy API call is received.
dateFinished.title: Date Finished

dateStarted.description: An optional ISO 8601 formatted date-time string (UTC is recommended) indicating when the deployment process started.
dateStarted.title: Date Started

environment.description: The name of the environment to which this release is being deployed (e.g., 'production', 'staging'). This environment must be known to Sentry.
environment.title: Environment

name.description: An optional human-readable name for the deploy.
name.title: Name

organization_id_or_slug.description: The unique identifier (ID) or human-readable slug of the Sentry organization.
organization_id_or_slug.title: Organization Id Or Slug

projects.description: An optional list of project slugs to associate this deploy with. If not provided, the deploy applies to all projects associated with the release.
projects.title: Projects

url.description: An optional URL that provides a link to the deployment, such as a commit or a CI build page.
url.title: Url

version.description: The version identifier of the release to be deployed. This version must already exist in Sentry.
version.title: Version

name: create_release_deploy_for_org

dateFinished.description: An optional date that indicates when the deploy ended. If not provided in the request, the current time is used
dateFinished.title: Date Finished

dateStarted.description: An optional date that indicates when the deploy started
dateStarted.title: Date Started

name.description: The optional name of the deploy
name.title: Name

url.description: The optional URL that points to the deploy
url.title: Url
